Question: My one friend is a mureed of some peer.and that peer himself is not keeping beard and peer saheb also said to my friend that "tumhari nani ko haj naseeb nahin hoga" so i want to know whether such person can be a real peer & whether he can say such statements related to future? Kindly guide us. Answer ID: 5282 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 718/668=D/1429) The person disobeying Shariah openly should not be made Pir (spiritual guide). His word: "tumhari nani ko haj naseeb nahin hoga" (your grandmother will not be able to perform Hajj) is also incorrect. Only Allah knows the ghaib (unseen). None is allowed to utter such a thing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
